title: DeepSeek Harness 傳出本週內測，能力對打 Claude Code
summary:
DeepSeek 自家的 Harness 工具傳出本週稍晚開啟內測，社群流傳的招募截圖顯示，首批用戶從小範圍群 […]

〈DeepSeek Harness 傳出本週內測，能力對打 Claude Code〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
DeepSeek 自家的 Harness 工具傳出本週稍晚開啟內測，社群流傳的招募截圖顯示，首批用戶從小範圍群組中篩選，入選者要提交個人資料並簽署《保密承諾函》才能拿到存取權限。截圖同時載明，一旦洩密不只當次資格取消，還會影響日後 DeepSeek 各類模型、產品內測以及合作機會的入選。據 Max For AI 爆料，由動區動趨整理報導。
（前情提要：DeepSeek V4 發布，程式能力可打敗 GPT 和 Claude 嗎？費用再次屠榜）
（背景補充：OpenAI 科學家建議：別在 Harness 上花太多力氣，下一代模型可能變內建）
重點摘要
- Max For AI 爆料 DeepSeek Harness 本週稍晚開內測，首批用戶從小範圍群組篩選
- 入選者須簽《保密承諾函》，洩密將連帶影響日後所有 DeepSeek 產品與合作資格
- 官方更新紀錄仍停在 4 月 24 日的 V4 Preview，正式版與 Harness 都尚未公布
三個月前，DeepSeek 在 V4 Preview 的官方發布頁上，還在教開發者怎麼把模型接進 Claude Code。三個月後，它準備開放內測的東西，是一個對著 Claude Code 打的自家產品。
7 月 28 日，Max For AI 爆料稱 DeepSeek 自家開發的 Harness 工具即將開始內測。社群流傳的內測招募截圖顯示，計畫在本週稍晚開啟，首批用戶從小範圍群組中篩選，入選者需要提交個人資料、簽署《保密承諾函》，才能拿到產品的存取權限。
洩密的代價
按照截圖的說法，一旦洩密，不只當次資格會被取消，還會影響之後 DeepSeek 各類模型、產品內測以及合作機會的入選。
這句話的份量，在於它把違約成本從一次性擴大到未來所有往來。簽下去的人抵押的不是這次的測試資格，是自己在 DeepSeek 生態裡的位置。
對一家四月才把 V4-Pro 的 1.6 兆參數權重直接丟上 Hugging Face、用 MIT 授權開源的公司來說，這個轉向本身就是訊號。模型可以送，工程層要鎖。
道理不難懂。模型的價值在權重，權重開源出去，別人也得自己備妥算力才跑得動。Harness 的價值在產品體驗和用戶實際怎麼用它，這種東西開源等於把產品直接交到對手手上。Anthropic 的 Claude Code 本身也是閉源的。
帶隊的是在 Jane Street 待了九年的人
DeepSeek 的 Harness 團隊不是這週才冒出來。5 月中下旬，DeepSeek 資深研究員陳德里在 X 和小紅書貼出招募訊息，開的是「Agent Harness 產品經理」與「Agent Harness 研發工程師」兩個職缺，工作地點限北京。職缺描述寫得很直白，「除模型本身以外的所有工作，都屬於 Harness 的範疇」，核心公式是「Model + Harness = Agent」。那則貼文帶著一句「簡歷直達部門老大」，衝出超過 30 萬次瀏覽。
帶隊的人選更值得看。據 5 月報導，前 TSY Capital 共同創辦人崔添翼今年 3 月加入 DeepSeek，出任新組建的 Harness 團隊負責人，主導一款對標 Claude Code 的桌面端 Agent 產品。他在華爾街量化巨頭 Jane Street 待了九年，大學期間六度拿下 ACM 亞洲區金牌，寫過在中文程式圈流傳多年的《背包問題九講》。
Jane Street 這個名字動區讀者不陌生，就是去年營收 396 億美元、人均薪酬 268 萬美元的那一間。DeepSeek 找量化背景的人來做編程工具，邏輯其實是通的。量化交易的核心從來不是策略多聰明，是執行系統能不能把策略變成錢。Agent 也一樣，模型再強，真正把智能變成產品的是外面那層 harness。
V4 正式版到現在還沒來
爆料的另一半是「如果消息屬實，V4 正式版和 Harness 將很快公布」。這句話能成立的前提，是 V4 正式版到今天都還沒發。
確實還沒有，DeepSeek API 官方文件的更新紀錄，最新一條停在 4 月 24 日的「DeepSeek V4 Preview Release」，Preview 是官方自己標的。V4-Pro（1.6 兆總參數、490 億啟用）與 V4-Flash（2,840 億總參數、130 億啟用）當時同步開源，預設上下文長度 100 萬 token。三個月過去，更新紀錄沒有再動過，也沒有任何一條跟 Harness 有關。
中文網路上倒是已經有不少「V4 正式版 7 月中全量商用」「首創峰谷分時定價、夜間算力費直降 60%」的說法。動區去查了 DeepSeek 官方定價頁，上面只有 deepseek-v4-flash 和 deepseek-v4-pro 兩個模型、一份價目表，沒有任何分時定價。
真正發生過的官方動作是另一件。舊的 API 別名 deepseek-chat 與 deepseek-reasoner 已於 7 月 24 日 15:59（UTC）全面退役，就在四天前。把舊入口清乾淨，通常是替新版本讓路。
目前這則內測爆料只有 Max For AI 一家提出，動區無法獨立驗證截圖真偽，DeepSeek 官方也沒有回應。按照截圖給的時程，本週稍晚就會知道答案。
常見問題
DeepSeek Harness 是什麼？
DeepSeek 自家開發中的 agent 工具，對標 Anthropic 的 Claude Code。團隊 5 月在北京開缺招募，核心公式是「Model + Harness = Agent」，負責模型以外的工具調用、上下文管理與終端執行。
DeepSeek V4 正式版發布了嗎？
還沒。官方 API 更新紀錄最新一條仍是 4 月 24 日的 V4 Preview，開源了 V4-Pro 與 V4-Flash。網路流傳的「7 月全量商用」「峰谷分時定價」說法，在官方定價頁上找不到對應。

title: MEXC研究》沉睡多年的比特幣巨鯨集中甦醒
summary:
7 月中下旬，幾個沉寂多年的早期比特幣錢包接連在鏈上甦醒，7 月 13 日 2,931 枚、7 月 16 日 […]

〈MEXC研究》沉睡多年的比特幣巨鯨集中甦醒〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
7 月中下旬，幾個沉寂多年的早期比特幣錢包接連在鏈上甦醒，7 月 13 日 2,931 枚、7 月 16 日 5,908 枚、7 月 20 日 700 枚，合計逾 6 億美元。MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊指出，三筆轉移的共同點是資金均未直接進入已知交易所，尚無證據表明存在即時拋售意圖。更值得注意的是供應端的大背景，據 Galaxy Research，2026 年古老籌碼的激活規模已不足 2025 年的一半，而據 K33，長期持有者持倉佔流通供應約 79%、為歷史最高。本文源自 MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊所著文章。
（前情提要：砸盤預警？中本聰時代遠古巨鯨甦醒，轉出 2650 枚 BTC 至機構交易平台）
（背景補充：到底誰在賣 BTC？數據：持比特幣 <5 年鯨魚是最大拋壓源）
概述
7 月中下旬，幾個沉寂多年的早期比特幣錢包接連在鏈上甦醒，把市場的注意力重新拉回到一個老問題上：那些成本極低、帳面浮盈數倍的古老籌碼，會不會在此刻變成實際拋壓。據 Arkham 追蹤、KuCoin 轉述的數據，7 月 13 日一個自 2018 年 10 月以來未曾動過的錢包（標籤為「356my」）將 2,931 枚比特幣轉入新地址，按當時約 6.4 萬美元的價格計算價值約 1.88 億美元，相對約 6,500 美元的持倉成本浮盈接近 10 倍。
幾天後的 7 月 16 日，據 Lookonchain 與 Arkham 的數據，另一個沉寂逾八年的地址轉移了 5,908 枚比特幣，價值約 3.83 億美元。7 月 20 日，據 COINOTAG 引述的鏈上記錄，一個休眠五年的地址轉移了 700 枚比特幣，購入成本約 2,234 萬美元，現值約 4,530 萬美元。這些轉移發生在比特幣徘徊於 6.4 萬美元、且距離 2025 年 10 月約 12.6 萬美元高點已回撤近五成的敏感時點，市場的疑問很直接：這是獲利了結的前奏，還是僅僅換倉。
核心要點
- 7 月 13 日，一個自 2018 年 10 月起休眠的錢包轉移 2,931 枚比特幣，約 1.88 億美元，成本價約 6,500 美元，浮盈近 10 倍，據 Arkham 追蹤資金流向的是新地址而非交易所。
- 7 月 16 日，一個沉寂逾八年、2017 年建倉的地址轉移 5,908 枚比特幣，約 3.83 億美元，同樣流向未標記的新地址，浮盈約 2.83 億美元。
- 7 月 20 日，一個休眠五年的地址轉移 700 枚比特幣，成本約 2,234 萬美元，現值約 4,530 萬美元。
- 三筆轉移的共同點是資金均未直接進入已知交易所，這意味著尚無證據表明存在即時拋售意圖。
- 據 Galaxy Research，2026 年古老籌碼的「甦醒」規模已不足 2025 年的一半，「大分配」進程基本接近尾聲。
- 據 K33，長期持有者持倉佔流通供應約 79%，為歷史最高，古幣重新激活量為 2012 年以來最低。
三筆轉移的事實拼圖
七年沉寂錢包的近十倍浮盈
時間線的起點是 7 月 13 日（部分數據源記為 7 月 12 日）。據 The Block 與相關鏈上梳理，一個自 2018 年 10 月 23 日以來未曾活動的地址，在美東時間下午移動了 2,931 枚比特幣至新錢包。據 Crypto Economy 引述 Arkham 的數據，資金從「356my」開頭的舊地址轉入「bc1qn」開頭的 bech32 新地址，該錢包上一次活動時比特幣價格約為 6,500 美元，按當前價格計算浮盈接近十倍。
關鍵細節在於目的地。據 CryptoNexa 的核查，截至報導時沒有證據顯示這 2,931 枚比特幣抵達任何中心化交易所，資金去向指向三種可能：冷錢包歸集、分散至多個地址，或後續存入交易所。在幣未進入交易所之前，任何關於拋售的判斷都只是推測。
八年巨鯨的三億美元換倉
規模更大的一筆發生在 7 月 16 日。據 Live Bitcoin News 引述 Lookonchain 與 Arkham 的數據，一個自 2017 年 12 月以來休眠的地址（標籤為「138EM…ReyiT」）轉移 5,908 枚比特幣，價值約 3.83 億美元。該地址建倉時比特幣價格約 1.68 萬美元，當時價值近 1 億美元，浮盈約 2.83 億美元。
據雅虎財經轉述的分析，Arkham 數據顯示這筆資金轉入一個新創建的未標記地址，而非已知交易所，市場上有觀點認為持有者更可能是在升級錢包，而非準備出售。值得注意的是，這筆轉移把幣從「1」開頭的舊格式地址轉入「bc1q」開頭的新格式地址，後者支援更低的手續費和現代錢包標準，這一細節支持「換倉而非拋售」的解讀。
五年沉寂地址的換倉
第三筆規模較小但同樣典型。據 COINOTAG 引述的鏈上記錄，7 月 20 日一個休眠五年的地址轉移了 700 枚比特幣，購入成本約 2,234 萬美元，現值約 4,530 萬美元，浮盈約一倍。資金被拆分至兩個新地址，其中約 697.68 枚集中在一個 bc1q 地址。這種「歸集後拆分至新地址」的模式，與前兩筆的換倉特徵一致。
市場為什麼在此刻格外敏感
價格與情緒處於脆弱位置
同樣的鏈上行為，在牛市和熊市中的解讀截然不同。據 Bitcoin Foundation 的報導，比特幣在 7 月中旬約 6.4 萬美元附近交易，較 2025 年 10 月約 12.6 萬美元的高點回撤近五成。當市場情緒脆弱、流動性下降時，任何一筆古老籌碼的移動都更容易被放大解讀為拋壓前兆。
據 Brave New Coin 引述 Santiment 的數據，鏈上分析師 Ali Martinez 在 7 月中旬發出高波動預警，指出比特幣的「幣齡消耗」（age-consumed）活動出現抬升，也就是老幣開始移動。這類指標的上行本身不等於拋售，但會推高市場對波動的預期。
交易所才是判斷拋壓的真正門檻
理解這類事件，關鍵在於區分「轉移」和「拋售」。加密資產必須先轉入交易所才能在公開市場賣出。據雅虎財經的報導，只要資金流向的是新創建的未標記地址而非交易所，就表明沒有即時出售的計劃。
這也是本輪三筆轉移與真正拋壓事件的分野。據 Coinidol 的整理，1.88 億美元和 3.83 億美元兩筆轉移均未產生直接的交易所存入，這讓比特幣得以在 6.4 萬美元附近企穩，7 月 21 日一度反彈至 6.6 萬美元。換言之，市場擔心的拋壓尚未在鏈上兌現。
放在更大的供應圖景裡看
大分配進程正在降溫
孤立地看，幾筆上億美元的轉移顯得驚人，但放在 2026 年的供應結構裡，它們更像是一個正在收尾的進程的餘波。據 Crypto Briefing 引述 Galaxy Digital 研究主管 Alex Thorn 的判斷，自 2017 年週期以來最大規模的古老籌碼再分配已基本完成，2026 年古幣的激活量預計不到 2025 年的一半。
這個「大分配」的高峰其實已經過去。據同一份報導，2025 年 7 月，Galaxy 曾代早期投資者執行一筆約 8 萬枚比特幣、當時價值約 90 億美元的轉移，是史上最大單筆比特幣交易之一。相比之下，本輪幾筆轉移的規模要小得多。
長期持有者仍在吸籌
供應端的另一面是長期持有者的行為。據 KuCoin 引述 K33 研究主管 Vetle Lunde 的數據，截至 6 月 6 日，2026 年僅有 218,421 枚兩年以上的比特幣被重新激活，遠低於 2024 年同期的 118 萬枚，是 2012 年以來的最低水平。與此同時，長期持有者持倉佔流通供應約 79%，為歷史最高。
這個背景很重要。它意味著，即便有個別古老錢包甦醒，整體上老籌碼的移動強度正在減弱，而非增強。據 CryptoSlate 引述 Galaxy Research 圖表的分析，一年期以上供應的移動量在 2024 年超過 400 萬枚，2026 年至今已降至 200 萬枚以下。
對投資者意味著什麼
對同時關注現貨與衍生品的投資者，這類事件的正確處理方式是把它當作一個需要跟蹤的信號，而非一個交易指令。鏈上轉移本身不改變供應總量，只改變籌碼的託管位置。真正需要警惕的是資金流向交易所的後續動作。
一個務實的框架是分層觀察：先確認幣是否進入交易所，再看交易所的老幣流入是否同步上升，最後結合 ETF 資金流和衍生品持倉判斷整體供需。據 CryptoDaily 的分析，當現貨需求穩定但交易所老幣流入抬升時，市場更可能呈現震盪回歸而非單邊趨勢，投資者可據此調整倉位節奏，避免一次性重倉。
風險與後續觀察點
換倉可能只是拋售的第一步
需要保持警惕的是，轉入新地址與隨後存入交易所之間可能只隔幾天。歷史上不乏古老錢包先歸集、再分批存入交易所的案例。若這幾個新地址在未來幾週出現向已知交易所的轉帳，拋壓敘事就會從推測變為現實。
一個法律變量
據雅虎財經引述 Galaxy Research 的報導，一起被稱為 Noah Doe 的訴訟在 2026 年 5 月浮出水面，一名匿名原告尋求約 380 萬枚沉睡比特幣的所有權，訴訟針對超過 3.9 萬個不活躍地址，主張這些幣已被「事實上放棄」。這類圍繞古老錢包所有權的法律爭議，可能促使部分持有者提前移動資金以證明控制權，從而增加古幣移動的頻率。這一變量與市場拋壓無直接關係，但會干擾對鏈上數據的解讀。
需要盯住的信號
未來幾週，四個信號值得跟蹤：這幾個新地址是否出現向交易所的轉帳、交易所的老幣流入指標是否抬升、比特幣能否重新站上約 6.9 萬美元讓近期買家回到成本線以上，以及現貨 ETF 的資金流方向。據 CryptoSlate 的分析，6.9 萬美元是判斷新一批持有者是否會因浮虧而投降式拋售的關鍵位置。
MEXC Crypto Pulse 研究團隊獨家觀點
這輪古老錢包甦醒真正重要的地方，不是幾筆上億美元的轉移本身，而是它們發生在一個「大分配」正在收尾、而非啟動的階段。市場的本能反應是把老幣移動等同於拋壓，但 2026 年的供應數據講的是一個相反的故事：古幣激活量降至 2012 年以來低位，長期持有者持倉佔比創歷史新高。孤立的幾筆轉移，很可能是這個降溫進程中的個案，而非新一輪分配的開端。
市場可能誤讀了兩件事。第一，把「轉入新地址」等同於「即將拋售」。三筆轉移無一直接進入交易所，且其中最大一筆明確從舊格式地址轉入支援低費用的新格式地址，更符合錢包升級或跨託管調倉的特徵，而非套現。第二，把鏈上「幣齡消耗」抬升當作趨勢反轉信號。在流通供應近八成被長期持有者鎖定的背景下，個別老幣的移動對整體流動性的邊際影響，遠小於比特幣早期。
如果只能盯一件事，我們建議盯交易所的老幣淨流入，而非孤立的錢包轉移新聞。轉移只是改變了籌碼的位置，交易所存入才是拋壓的必要前提。一筆資金在新地址靜止不動，與它出現在交易所熱錢包，對市場的含義完全不同。
對加密市場的啟發在於，鏈上透明度是一把雙刃劍。它讓每一筆巨鯨移動都無所遁形，但也讓市場容易對「轉移」過度反應，把託管行為誤讀為交易行為。隨著機構託管、ETF 和跨託管調倉成為常態，古老錢包的移動會越來越頻繁地反映營運需求，而非方向性押注。真正成熟的讀法，是把鏈上數據當作需要交叉驗證的線索，而非可以直接交易的信號。在一個長期持有者主導、且分配進程接近尾聲的週期裡，供應的稀缺性敘事，可能比單筆拋壓的噪音更值得關注。
常見問題
沉睡錢包轉移比特幣就一定會砸盤嗎？
不一定。加密資產必須先轉入交易所才能在公開市場出售。本輪 7 月的三筆轉移，資金均流向新創建的未標記地址而非已知交易所，這意味著截至目前沒有證據表明存在即時拋售意圖。只有當這些幣出現向交易所的後續轉帳時，拋壓才會從推測變為現實。在此之前，轉移更可能是換倉、錢包升級或跨託管調倉。
為什麼這些錢包選擇在 7 月移動？
公開數據無法確認持有者的具體動機。常見的解讀包括早期礦工或加密基金進行跨託管商調倉、升級到支援低手續費的新格式地址、在宏觀事件前進行風險管理，或應對圍繞古老錢包所有權的法律爭議。由於這些地址均為匿名，任何單一動機都只是推測，不應被寫成確定結論。
這次轉移的規模在歷史上算大嗎？
不算特別大。本輪最大一筆為 5,908 枚比特幣，約 3.83 億美元。作為對比，據 Galaxy Digital，2025 年 7 月曾有一筆約 8 萬枚比特幣、當時價值約 90 億美元的轉移，是史上最大單筆之一。據 Galaxy Research，2026 年古幣的激活量預計不到 2025 年的一半，說明大規模分配的高峰已經過去。
什麼是大分配（Great Redistribution）？
指 2024 年至 2025 年間，大量早期比特幣持有者在價格突破 10 萬美元後，將長期持有的籌碼轉移給新買家的過程。據 CryptoQuant 與 Galaxy Research，這一進程已基本接近尾聲，2026 年老幣的移動強度顯著下降。機構「新巨鯨」透過 ETF 和場外交易吸收了大部分釋放的供應。
如何判斷一筆巨鯨轉移會不會帶來拋壓？
關鍵看資金是否流向交易所。可分三步觀察：先確認目的地是新地址還是交易所；再看交易所整體的老幣流入指標是否同步抬升；最後結合 ETF 資金流和衍生品持倉判斷供需。若幣停留在非交易所地址，對市場的即時影響有限。
這對比特幣價格意味著什麼？
短期影響取決於這些幣是否進入交易所。截至目前，三筆轉移未產生直接的交易所存入，比特幣得以在約 6.4 萬美元企穩。中期看，古幣激活量下降和長期持有者持倉佔比創歷史新高，指向供應端的收緊，這與單筆轉移的短期噪音方向相反。投資者需要區分這兩個時間維度。
接下來最該關注什麼？
四個信號：這幾個新地址是否出現向交易所的轉帳、交易所老幣淨流入是否抬升、比特幣能否重新站上約 6.9 萬美元、以及現貨 ETF 的資金流方向。任何一項轉向，都會改變當前「轉移已發生但拋壓未兌現」的判斷。
*本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議。文中引用的鏈上數據、地址標籤與成本估算來自 Arkham、Lookonchain 等第三方追蹤平台及公開媒體，可能存在延遲或誤標，鏈上地址的所有者身份與轉移動機通常無法確認，相關解讀均為推測，讀者應自行核實。加密資產價格波動劇烈，投資前請審慎評估自身風險承受能力。*

title: Meta 最新 AI 廣告，但配樂是「地球快毀滅了」
summary:
Meta 在 7 月 23 日推出 45 秒 AI 品牌廣告〈The Future Is for Everyo […]

〈Meta 最新 AI 廣告，但配樂是「地球快毀滅了」〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Meta 在 7 月 23 日推出 45 秒 AI 品牌廣告〈The Future Is for Everyone〉，祖克柏親自發布，畫面從黑白的 AI 恐慌標題轉成彩色的擁抱與跳舞，旁白說「未來屬於每一個人」。配樂卻是 David Bowie 1972 年的〈Five Years〉，一首唱人類得知地球五年後將因大規模滅絕事件毀滅的歌。Meta 發言人回應，David Bowie 本人認為那是一首樂觀的歌。
（前情提要：彭博：Meta 正秘密打造雲端業務，出售過剩 AI 算力挑戰三大巨頭）
（背景補充：祖克柏遭爆使用 AI token 數量在 Meta 吊車尾，還要求員工跟他的 AI 分身對話）
重點摘要
- Meta 45 秒 AI 廣告配樂選了 David Bowie 唱地球毀滅的〈Five Years〉
- 皮尤調查顯示僅 16% 美國人看好 AI 未來 20 年影響，40% 看壞
- Meta 2026 年資本支出指引已上調至 1,250 億至 1,450 億美元
祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）7 月 23 日親自發布 Meta 最新的 AI 品牌廣告〈The Future Is for Everyone〉。Meta 創意團隊端出的畫面很暖心，但美國網友驚覺配樂卻是 David Bowie 1972 年的〈Five Years〉，一首主題是人類得知地球五年後就會毀滅的歌。
開場是黑白的一顆眼睛，瞳孔裡掃過一則則 AI 恐慌標題。旁白說：「有些人要你相信 AI 會讓我們更不親近，會把我們拋在後面。我們完全不同意。」畫面接著轉成彩色，屋頂上情侶跳舞指著彩虹、青少年在湖裡游泳、朋友相擁，全部包成 Instagram 貼文。
收尾旁白是：「說我們是樂觀主義者，說我們是作夢的人，你想怎麼說都行。但我們押注在人身上，而且我們喜歡這個賠率。未來屬於每一個人。」
那首歌唱的是新聞主播哭著宣布世界要毀滅
〈Five Years〉1971 年 11 月錄於倫敦 Trident Studios，1972 年 6 月 16 日隨專輯《The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars》發行，是整張的開場曲。設定是地球因為天然資源耗盡只剩五年壽命。David Bowie 1973 年對《Rolling Stone》講得很白：「已經宣布了，世界會因為天然資源短缺而毀滅。」
廣告剪進去的那一段，剛好是歌裡不斷重複「people」的部分，抽掉脈絡確實像在講人跟人的連結。但緊接在前面的幾句，唱的是新聞主播哭著說地球真的要死了，只剩五年可以哭。剪的人挑得很準，準到讓人懷疑是不是故意的。
Meta 表示 David Bowie 本人覺得這首歌很樂觀
面對嘲諷，Meta 發言人向外媒表示，David Bowie 認為〈Five Years〉是一首關於「對未來抱持樂觀」的歌。David Bowie 遺產管理方目前沒有公開回應。不過 2022 年 1 月遺產管理方已把他的出版目錄以逾 2.5 億美元賣給華納 Chappell Music，涵蓋生前 26 張錄音室專輯，《Ziggy Stardust》也在裡面，授權未必由家屬拍板。
撰寫社群工作電子報的 Rachel Karten 在 X 上寫：「meta 的 AI 樂觀廣告配的是 David Bowie 的〈Five Years〉，一首關於五年內會毀滅地球的末日災難的歌。」科技評論者 Louis Anslow 則問：「這是讓 AI 反對者幫忙擴散廣告的聰明作法？」
1,450 億美元買一個樂觀敘事
Meta 行銷長 Denise Moreno 說明拍片動機：「在這麼多雜訊裡，很容易覺得未來正走向更少的連結和更少的自主。我們採取不同立場，我們認為 AI 會讓人有能力多做自己喜歡的事。」
皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）調查則顯示，只有 16% 的美國人認為 AI 在未來 20 年會對社會帶來正面影響，40% 認為負面。
廣告背後是巨量投入，Meta 已把 2026 年資本支出指引從 1,150 億至 1,350 億美元上調到 1,250 億至 1,450 億美元，財務長 Susan Li 說增幅來自「支持 Meta Superintelligence Labs 與核心業務的投資增加」，作為對照，2024 年全年是 722 億美元。
時間點也很尷尬。7 月 7 日上線的 Instagram 生圖功能 Muse Image 允許引用他人公開照片生成圖像、而且預設開啟，SAG-AFTRA 與多位演員抗議可能被做成非自願的數位分身，Meta 幾天內撤掉功能，承認「沒抓到重點」。
7 月 9 日 Anthropic 的品牌片則因為放進燃燒的房子、監視畫面和墓園，被 Sam Altman 在 X 上調侃「我以為這是諷刺作品，一直在找帳號是不是拼成 c1audeai」。
AI 議題不斷刺激社群的神經，Meta 似乎在近期犯了不少瑕疵。
常見問題
Meta 的 AI 廣告為什麼被嘲諷？
Meta 7 月 23 日推出的 45 秒廣告〈The Future Is for Everyone〉主打 AI 讓人更靠近，配樂卻選了 David Bowie 1972 年的〈Five Years〉，那首歌唱的是人類得知地球五年後毀滅後陷入恐慌。
David Bowie 的〈Five Years〉在唱什麼？
〈Five Years〉是 1972 年專輯《The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars》的開場曲，設定是地球因天然資源耗盡只剩五年，歌詞從新聞主播哭著宣布這則消息開始。

title: 被 AI 裁員的記者，發現公司還用自己名字發文章
summary:
自由撰稿人 Ben Touati 今年 3 月被 ClickOut Media 裁掉，主管給的理由是同事都用 […]

〈被 AI 裁員的記者，發現公司還用自己名字發文章〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
自由撰稿人 Ben Touati 今年 3 月被 ClickOut Media 裁掉，主管給的理由是同事都用 AI 把產能拉上去了、沒有那麼多工作。兩個月後，他在自己的作者頁上看到五篇沒寫過的賭場攻略，署名全是他。他依歐盟 GDPR 提出個資遭濫用的申訴，公司才把署名撤掉，而 7 月又冒出 28 篇。
（前情提要：林上倫律師專文》AI 變成裁員的萬用藉口！科技公司的集體甩鍋）
（背景補充：紐時董事長演講：媒體在AI時代該如何生存？我勸業界站起來反抗）
重點摘要
- Ben Touati 3 月被裁，5 月 26 日發現五篇 AI 賭場文掛他署名
- 6 月 2 日提 GDPR 申訴後署名才撤下，7 月又冒出 28 篇
- 母公司 Finixio 2024 年營收 4,000 萬英鎊，握有 200 多個網域
今年 5 月 26 日，Ben Touati 打開 Esports Insider 的網站，在自己的作者頁上看到五篇文章。標題全是賭場攻略，內文鬆散空洞，他形容那些稿子「就是很懶，明顯就是 slop（AI 灌出來的劣質內容），明顯背後沒有一個真人」。
但每一篇的作者署名都是自己，Ben Touati。
而他早在兩個多月前，就被這家公司裁掉了。
據 Press Gazette 報導，這五篇的發布時間全部落在清晨五點三十九分到六點之間，一天一篇，連續發到 5 月 29 日。文章裡還留著一些奇怪的標記，Ben Touati 說那是 AI 的手筆。他對 Press Gazette 說，「這是實實在在的打臉。」
裁員理由是 AI
Ben Touati 人在斯德哥爾摩，是替 ClickOut Media 供稿的自由撰稿人，寫過 Techopedia、Esports Insider 和 The Escapist，題目橫跨 AI、加密貨幣、科技、遊戲、電競和漫畫。他被找進來的時候，主管管他叫「Nerd in Chief」（首席宅男），雖然那並不是正式職稱。
他說那段日子他是全力以赴的。「我甚至寫了關於漫畫的文章，那幾乎是我一輩子的夢想。我拿到活動的採訪證，那類的東西。」
3 月 9 日，公司收回他的系統權限。3 月 23 日起，僱用關係結束。主管給的理由有兩層，表層是 Esports Insider 被 Google 從索引裡移除，撐不出足夠的收入。裡面的原因是主管說他放走了好幾位自由撰稿人，因為工作量不夠，而且每個人都已經用 AI「把產能拉上去」了。
兩個月後，那些被拉上去的產能，用他的名字發了五篇文章。
公司用自己的名字違法
6 月 2 日，Ben Touati 依歐盟 GDPR 對 ClickOut Media 提出申訴，主張自己的個人資料遭到濫用。GDPR 把姓名視為個人資料，資料不正確時，當事人可以要求更正或刪除。申訴之後，公司把那五篇文章的署名撤掉了，改掛另一個寫作者的名字。
他要回來的不是稿費，是自己的名字。
ClickOut Media 在英國登記的實體叫 Finixio。英國《1988 年著作權、設計與專利法》第 84 條寫得很直白，任何人都有權不被錯誤標示為某個作品的作者；明知或有理由相信標示不實，仍把作品散布給公眾的人，就侵害了這項權利，而且這項權利在當事人身故後 20 年內仍然存在。伯恩公約第 6 條之二保障的是「主張自己是作者」，第 84 條保障的則是相反的那一面，不被硬掛上自己沒寫的東西。
ClickOut Media 對外的回應，從頭到尾只有兩句話。
我們在適當的情況下使用 AI 輔助內容，並搭配人工檢查與編輯。我們持續改進 AI 代理的準確度，也改進我們的人工編輯流程。
這段聲明沒有解釋，為什麼一家公司要用前員工的名字，替 AI 生成的稿子著名。
署名被撤下後這件事還沒結束，Press Gazette 在 7 月 15 日更新報導，德文版的 Esports Insider 重新上線後，站上出現 28 篇賭場相關文章，發布日期橫跨 5 月 15 日到 7 月 14 日，署名還是 Ben Touati。他說，「每一篇都落在 3 月 9 日之後，那天 ClickOut 收回我的權限，而從 3 月 23 日起我根本不是員工。」這段續集目前只有 Press Gazette 一家報導。
- 3 月 9 日: ClickOut Media 收回 Ben Touati 的系統權限
- 3 月 23 日: 僱用關係結束
- 5 月 26 日: 他在自己的作者頁上發現五篇沒寫過的文章
- 6 月 2 日: 依 GDPR 提出申訴，署名隨後撤下
- 7 月 15 日: Press Gazette 更新，德文站上再冒出 28 篇
200 個網域的機器，記不得誰寫過什麼
ClickOut Media 自稱是專攻 web3、金融與科技的行銷公司。Press Gazette 指出，母公司 Finixio 在 2024 年營收約 4,000 萬英鎊，管理層人在馬爾他，手上握著 200 多個網域。它的模式是買下已經有讀者、有 Google 權重的科技與遊戲媒體，把記者換成 AI，再把賭場的推薦連結塞進去。Google 給這種操作取了個名字叫網站聲譽濫用，業界則直接叫它寄生 SEO。
被買下的名單包括 The Escapist、Videogamer、Esports Insider、Techopedia、Sportscasting、She Kicks 和 GamesHub。Press Gazette 在 2 月的調查裡點名過兩個「記者」，Brian Merrygold 和 Callum Mercer。兩人的大頭照經 IdentifAI 檢測是 AI 生成，文章經 Pangram 檢測也是 AI 生成。Brian Merrygold 的簡介說他是「資深的 iGaming 與運動博弈分析師」，還是個「終身玩家」。Metacritic 後來刪掉了 Brian Merrygold 那篇《惡靈古堡：安魂曲》評測，共同創辦人 Marc Doyle 講得很乾脆，「Metacritic 的政策是絕對不收錄 AI 生成的評論家評測。」
有些 AI 記者的頭像檔名裡，還留著 ChatGPT 這幾個字。
2023 年的做法是憑空捏造一個不存在的人，2026 年的做法是拿一個存在的人，用 AI 替換掉。
TechCrunch 在 7 月 25 日更新了一份清單，統計 2026 年公開把裁員理由指向 AI 的大型科技公司。Monday.com 在 7 月宣布裁掉約 630 人、大約兩成員工，成為名單上的第 21 家。TechCrunch 引述金融時報的統計，美國科技業今年以來已經砍掉將近 14 萬個職位。
多數人被裁之後，名字就從公司網站上一起消失了，他的沒有。
常見問題
ClickOut Media 是什麼樣的公司？
它在英國登記的實體是 Finixio，2024 年營收約 4,000 萬英鎊、握有 200 多個網域。做法是買下有 Google 權重的科技與遊戲媒體，把記者換成 AI，再置入賭場連結，也就是業界說的寄生 SEO。
GDPR 為什麼能用來處理署名被冒用？
GDPR 把姓名視為個人資料，資料不正確時當事人可以要求更正或刪除。Ben Touati 於 6 月 2 日提出申訴，主張個資遭濫用，ClickOut Media 隨後把那五篇文章的署名改掉。各家報導未載明他援引的條文。

title: 從 UNIS 到 KISS OF LIFE：為什麼 NEXST  是 2026 年少數「先有產品、再發代幣」的娛樂公鏈項目
summary:
NEXST 是一個以 AI+VR+Web3 為基礎的娛樂基礎設施專案，有別於先發代幣再開發產品的做法，它先推出 […]

〈從 UNIS 到 KISS OF LIFE：為什麼 NEXST 是 2026 年少數「先有產品、再發代幣」的娛樂公鏈項目〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
NEXST 是一個以 AI+VR+Web3 為基礎的娛樂基礎設施專案，有別於先發代幣再開發產品的做法，它先推出 VR 演唱會平台 Xmersive 並登上 Meta Quest 商店，與 K-pop 女團 UNIS 和 KISS OF LIFE 合作，再由日本上市公司 monoAI 承接開發，最後於 2026 年 5 月發行代幣 $NXT。專案提供沉浸式演唱會體驗、數位小卡收藏及 AI 共創工具，目標將一次性演出轉化為可持有的資產，已在 OKX、KuCoin 等交易所上線。
（前情提要：田柾國大跳的《GG EZ》沒有歌手：韓國封殺 AI 版稅，擋不住 9160 萬次觀看）
（背景補充：彭博分析師：比特幣 ETF 單週吸金 7.5 億鎂，OG 收手必反彈）
音樂 NFT 平台接連倒下、HYBE 收掉區塊鏈子公司之後，Web3 娛樂還有機會嗎？NEXST 先把 VR 演唱會平台 Xmersive 做上 Meta Quest，與 K-pop 女團 UNIS、KISS OF LIFE 完成合作，再於 2026 年 5 月發行 $NXT。本文從賽道痛點、產品實證到代幣邏輯，完整拆解這個 AI＋VR＋Web3 娛樂基礎設施專案。
K-pop 巨頭 HYBE 在 2025 年賺進創紀錄的 18.6 億美元營收，卻在同一年默默收掉了自己的區塊鏈子公司，這家子公司 2023 年全年營收只有約 318 美元。
這不是個案。3LAU 創辦、a16z 領投、累計募資約 7,100 萬美元的音樂版稅平台 Royal，據產業回顧已於 2024 年底停止營運；音樂公鏈 Audius 的代幣較 2021 年高點跌去約 95%。過去五年，「音樂上鏈」幾乎是 Web3 死亡率最高的賽道之一。
問題出在哪？答案殘酷而簡單：這些專案先發了幣，卻始終沒做出粉絲真正想用的產品。
2026 年，一個從 VR 演唱會切入的專案給出了不同的解法。NEXST 先把產品做上 Meta Quest 商店、先和兩組 K-pop 女團完成正式合作、先讓日本上市公司接手開發，最後才發行代幣 $NXT。這個順序上的差異，正是本文想拆解的核心。
粉絲經濟很值錢，但粉絲什麼都帶不走
粉絲經濟的規模不需要懷疑。HYBE 旗下粉絲平台 Weverse 的月活躍使用者在 2025 年創下 1,200 萬新高、使用者月均停留 263 分鐘；SM 系的私訊訂閱平台 bubble 母公司 Dear U 年營收約 749 億韓元，SM 更在 2025 年 3 月斥資約 9,200 萬美元加碼收購其股權。根據 Luminate 的調查，美國有 15% 的人口是「超級粉絲」，月支出比一般聽眾高 80%，其中 K-pop 粉絲的消費力又比平均高出 75%。
但這套經濟有一個結構性缺陷：粉絲花的每一筆錢，都是一次性的。 演唱會散場、訂閱到期、專輯拆完小卡之後，粉絲手上不會留下任何可持有、可轉讓的東西。價值全部沉澱在平台和經紀公司，粉絲只是不斷付費的過路客。
Web3 曾承諾解決這件事，卻大多死在「只有代幣、沒有產品」上。這正是評估任何娛樂類專案的第一道濾網：先看產品，再看白皮書。
NEXST 的定位：不是又一個娛樂代幣，而是基礎設施層
NEXST 是一個以 AI＋VR＋Web3 為技術底座的娛樂基礎設施專案，目標是把「一次性的演出」轉化為「可持續參與、可持有的資產」，用官方的說法：不只是聽音樂，而是擁有那個瞬間。
它的生態由三層組成。體驗層是 VR 演唱會平台 Xmersive，提供 180 度高解析度的沉浸式 LIVE，觀眾能以「站在舞臺前排」的視角觀看演出，並透過配套應用 PhotoEX 收藏數位小卡。創作層是 AI 社交平台 SAI，讓粉絲用 AI 影像與短影片工具參與內容共創。資產層則是規劃中的 娛樂 RWA 平台，白皮書描繪了門票、周邊、獨家內容與版稅收益權的代幣化藍圖。
更長線的野心，是 NEXST 官方提出的 NEXST-Gen Alliance，一個專注 AI 偶像的經紀模式，並配套 1,000 萬枚 $NXT 的專項基金，用於與主流藝人及新一代 AI 偶像共同製作內容。在 PLAVE 單週專輯銷量破百萬張、SM 推出 AI 藝人 naevis 的今天，虛擬偶像已被驗證是真實市場（SNS Insider 估計全球虛擬偶像與 VTuber 市場 2025 年約 22.7 億美元，2035 年上看 107.5 億美元）；NEXST 想做的，是成為這個市場裡「AI 偶像 × 鏈上所有權」交叉點上的第一批基礎設施，其願景是打造能與 JYP、SM、YG 旗下偶像同場競技的劃時代 AI 偶像。
NEXST 在代幣外，已有現金流入口
判斷一個娛樂專案是敘事還是實業，最好的方法是把時間線攤開。
2025 年 7 月，NEXST 宣布 K-pop 女團 UNIS（F&F Entertainment）成為 VR LIVE 首位全球合作藝人。2026 年 1 月，拿下 2025 AAA「Best Musician Group」的 KISS OF LIFE（S2 Entertainment）成為第二組官方合作藝人。2026 年 4 月 8 日，Xmersive 正式登上 Meta Quest 全球商店；5 月 13 日 iOS／Android 手機版全球同步上線。2026 年 5 月 11 日，NEXST 日本法人與「東京證交所 Growth 市場上市公司 monoAI technology（證券程式碼 5240）」宣布業務提攜，由這家深耕 XR／元宇宙的上市公司承接 Xmersive 與 PhotoEX 的系統開發。6 月，KISS OF LIFE 日本出道巡演的 VR 實錄內容開賣。
這條時間線的關鍵在於順序：產品上線、藝人合作、上市公司技術背書，全部發生在代幣發行之前或緊隨其後。 首發內容「Xmersive:UNIS」在 Quest 商店定價 39.99 美元，KISS OF LIFE 巡演內容定價 29.99 美元，這意味著 NEXST 在代幣之外，已經有真實的內容銷售現金流入口。對比多數娛樂代幣把一切承諾放在路線圖上，NEXST 的核心產品現在就能下載。
生態與代幣邏輯：$NXT 怎麼捕獲價值
$NXT 於 2026 年 5 月 12 日完成 TGE，同日上線 OKX Boost、KuCoin、MEXC、LBank 四所，另有 PancakeSwap 流動性，發行於 BNB Chain，總量 6 億枚。代幣設計上有兩個值得注意的細節：TGE 初始流通僅 1.34%，且官方宣告無 VC 於 TGE 解鎖、團隊代幣鎖倉 12 個月。
截至 2026 年 7 月 22 日，$NXT 報價約 0.155 美元，較上線首日低點（約 0.093 美元，CoinGecko）上漲約 67%，6 月初曾觸及 0.46 美元高點。
在生態內，$NXT 的角色是功能代幣：VR 演唱會門票與許可權、AI 進階功能與粉絲投票、NFT 內容解鎖與生態獎勵，未來並將貫穿 RWA 資產化與 NEXST-Gen Alliance 的內容製作基金。換句話說，$NXT 的價值捕獲邏輯不是「炒作藝人熱度」，而是繫結平台的內容消費與資產化需求，這拉開它與上一代「蹭 IP 發幣」專案的本質區別。
對照表：NEXST 在娛樂科技版圖中的位置
後續里程碑與結語
接下來值得追蹤的節點，依官方規劃包括：東南亞與歐美市場擴張、新一輪 CEX 上架公告、SAI 與 RWA 平台的落地進度，以及 NEXST-Gen Alliance 首個 AI 偶像企劃的公開。每一項都是可驗證的檢查點，這也是分析一個「基礎設施敘事」最健康的方式：不看它說了什麼，看它下一個給什麼到市場。
回到粉絲的視角做個收尾。想要無限量的音樂串流，你會去 Spotify；想要偶像的貼身訊息，你會去 bubble；但如果你想要的是把「我在現場」變成一件真正屬於你、可以留存與流通的資產，目前把產品、藝人、代幣三件事都擺上檯面的，NEXST 是這個交叉點上最值得關注的名字。
親自體驗是最快的驗證方式：Xmersive 已可在 Meta Quest 商店與 iOS／Android 下載，官方資訊可關注 nexst.io 與官方 X（@NEXST_AI）。$NXT 現已於 OKX、KuCoin、MEXC、LBank 交易。
本文不構成投資建議。加密資產價格波動劇烈，$NXT 上線時間尚短，請自行研究（DYOR），注意風險。

title: 林上倫律師專文》素人用 AI 寫法律訴狀，是在自掘墳墓
summary:
生成式 AI 讓法院出現「書狀大爆炸」，執業律師林上倫投書指出，素人把案情丟給 ChatGPT 或 Gemin […]

〈林上倫律師專文》素人用 AI 寫法律訴狀，是在自掘墳墓〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
生成式 AI 讓法院出現「書狀大爆炸」，執業律師林上倫投書指出，素人把案情丟給 ChatGPT 或 Gemini 生出來的書狀，在法官與對造律師眼裡不僅漏洞百出，更可能讓當事人踩進誣告與誹謗的刑責。他點名市面上法律 AI 查詢工具採用的「爬蟲抓取加向量資料庫（RAG）」存在兩個硬傷，而專業律師最歡迎的對手，就是拿著 AI 書狀來起訴的素人。
（前情提要：林上倫律師專文》放大與加速：被 99% 法律人錯過的 AI 真實能力）
（背景補充：林上倫律師專文》當文字成為流水線：AI對法律產業的工業革命）
最近生成式 AI 成了各行各業的顯學。在法律圈，最顯著的現象就是「法院書狀大爆炸」。
許多遇到糾紛的民眾，為了省下律師費，開始嘗試自己當律師。他們把案情大綱往 ChatGPT 或 Gemini 一丟，按個 Enter，一份看起來有模有樣的起訴狀或告訴狀就誕生了。這些素人捧著這些 AI 書狀信心滿滿地遞向法院，以為自己拿到了對抗專業的「神兵利器」。
在第一線觀察，就會發現這是一個巨大的災難。素人們自以為聰明的做法，在法官與對造律師眼裡，不僅漏洞百出，甚至正在把當事人自己推向犯罪的邊緣。我想從專業律師的角度，聊聊為什麼素人盲信 AI 寫書狀，最後往往會變成一場自毀前程的悲劇。
一、法律沒有絕對真理，但 AI 只想當個「討好你」的應聲蟲
許多人對 AI 有一個根本性的誤解，以為它是一個「客觀的法律百科全書」。但事實上，法律的世界從來就不是非黑即白的自然科學。
任何一個法律爭議，背後都有無數種解釋空間。當你在沒有提供任何權威實務見解的前提下，白紙一張地直接去問 AI 某個行為「對不對」或「能不能告」時，AI 的底層邏輯不是去幫你尋找客觀的法律真理，而是去「揣摩你的語氣，給出你最想聽的答案」。
這種「討好型人格」是 AI 的特性。當你抱著滿腔怨氣問它「對方這樣是不是詐欺」時，AI 為了迎合你的情緒，會順著你的邏輯，用極其專業的法律術語，編造出一套看似無懈可擊、實則完全脫離現實的起訴理由。你以為自己得到了法律證實，其實只是跟一個高度社會化的「應聲蟲」集體自嗨了一場。
二、從「誣告」到「誹謗」
很多人以為，用 AI 寫寫狀子，頂多就是告不成、被法官駁回而已。但事實上，AI 為了幫你拼湊出符合犯罪或侵權的構成要件，極有可能在書狀中「自動加料、憑空捏造」一些你根本沒有提過的事實細節。不只會導致敗訴，更會有被刑事追訴的風險：
1. 遞交法院時：涉犯「誣告罪」
當你把 AI 虛構的細節（例如：對方當場恐嚇要對你動手、或者對方明知是假貨還故意設局）當作真實事實簽名送交法院或檢察署，一旦檢方查明事實根本不符，你就構成了虛構事實申告他人犯罪的誣告行為。這是直接對司法機關的欺騙。
2. 發布到網路上時：涉犯「誹謗與公然侮辱」
這在實務上更常見。很多素人氣不過，不僅把 AI 寫的告訴狀送去法院，還順手把這份「添油加醋」的起訴草稿或聲明書，直接貼到 Facebook、Threads 或爆料公社上進行「網路公審」。
一旦你把這些含有 AI 虛構、未經證實的貶損言詞發布到公開網路，對方立刻可以反過來告你誹謗與公然侮辱。到時候你在法庭上辯稱「這都是 AI 幫我寫的，我只是複製貼上」，根本不會有法官甩你。因為按下「發布鍵」的人是你，你必須對傳播虛假言論負起刑事責任。
三、為什麼連專業軟體的「爬蟲建庫」，依然會集體幻想
這時候有人會說：「那我不用一般的 ChatGPT，我用市面上那些號稱專門給法律人用的 AI 查詢軟體，總該沒問題了吧？」
很遺憾，答案依然是：照樣會出錯，而且錯得神不知鬼不覺。
目前市面上所謂的「法律 AI 查詢工具」，絕大多數都是採用「爬蟲抓取 + 向量資料庫（RAG）」的技術。這種技術有兩個無法克服的硬傷：
- 脈絡斷裂：法律判決書動輒幾千甚至上萬字，這些軟體為了讓 AI 讀得懂，會用爬蟲把司法院的判決書整批抓下來，然後「切片」成無數個小碎片存進資料庫。當你查詢時，AI 只是去撈出幾個「看起來相關的碎片」，然後用它地端的弱模型去拼湊答案。這種「斷章取義」的作法，經常會把 A 案件的理由套在 B 案件的結論上，產生嚴重的邏輯張冠李戴。
- 資訊落後與重製侵權：自建的資料庫永遠有時間差，無法做到即時更新。更不用說，這種大規模爬取、儲存司法院資料庫的行為，在法律上一直有侵害「編輯著作重製權」的合規疑慮。
這就是為什麼，專業的法律 AI 團隊是改用最新的 MCP 技術。MCP 的厲害之處在於，它「不儲存、不爬取、不切片」。當我們向 AI 發出查詢時，MCP 就像是一個即時的官方傳送門，直接讓 AI 以安全、合規的方式連線到司法院官方網站，把最新、最完整的判決書原封不動地拿過來讀。因為讀的是百分之百真實的「正版官方原文」，AI 不需要憑空猜測，自然能做到零幻想、零出錯。
四、用 AI 寫狀的對造，是專業律師的最愛
在訴訟實務上，當我們發現對造素人是拿著 AI 寫的書狀來起訴時，我們通常會鬆一口氣，因為這意味著，對方主動把必敗的破綻送到了我們手上。
AI 寫的書狀，其邏輯鏈條往往經不起推敲。我們會仔細進行「AI 抓漏閱卷」：
- 核對它引用的最高法院案號，十之八九是 AI 憑空捏造的「幻覺判決」。
- 拆解它主張的事實，會發現裡面充滿了不合常理、且完全沒有任何客觀證據佐證的虛構情節。
我們只需要在法庭上冷靜地向法官指出這些「捏造的案號」與「虛構的事實」，法官對該當事人的誠信度就會大幅下降。這不僅讓對方當場輸掉官司，更為我們後續反告對方誣告、要求民事賠償提供了切入點。
五、不要用你的業餘，去挑戰別人的專業
AI 確實降低了許多技術的門檻，但它從來沒有降低「專業」的價值。尤其是在容錯率為零、動輒影響一個人自由與財產的法律領域，盲目使用消費級 AI 寫狀，無異於是在裸奔。
現在的 AI，就像是《哈利波特》裡那根最厲害的萬用魔杖。你可以用它來施展強大的魔法，但前提是，你必須自己先學會怎麼念咒語、怎麼調動體內的魔力。它只是一個工具，而不是一個能直接幫你打贏佛地魔的「鄧不利多」或「麥教授」。
如果你本身是個法律素人，連基本的訴訟攻防、證據法則、實務邏輯都不懂，卻妄想拿著這根魔杖在法庭上亂揮，下場只會是被自己的魔咒反彈、當場炸飛。在法律這個容錯率極低、動輒影響一個人自由與財產的戰場上，盲目使用消費級 AI 寫狀，完全是標準的自陷入罪。
在 AI 時代，那些懂得利用像 MCP 這種尖端技術、將 AI 作為專業放大器的律師會大幅獲益；而那些企圖用 AI 走捷徑、省小錢的素人，最終很可能只會在法庭上，為自己的無知付出慘痛的代價。
常見問題
用 AI 寫的訴訟書狀會有什麼法律風險？
作者指出兩種刑責風險。把 AI 虛構的事實細節簽名遞交法院或檢察署，可能構成誣告罪；把含有 AI 虛構內容的起訴草稿貼到 Facebook、Threads 或爆料公社，對方可以反過來告誹謗與公然侮辱。
號稱專門給法律人用的 AI 查詢工具為什麼還是會出錯？
作者指出市面上多數工具採用「爬蟲抓取加向量資料庫（RAG）」，把判決書切片存庫。查詢時 AI 只撈出看似相關的碎片拼湊答案，容易把 A 案理由套到 B 案結論，且自建資料庫有時間差與重製侵權疑慮。

title: 北韓也防不了自己人？前軍方駭客攻破銀行，盜國家資金轉進加密幣
summary:
北韓遭爆自家人入侵銀行案！前軍方駭客與學生聯手滲透兩大國營銀行，將資金轉為加密貨幣並走私外匯，隨後遭當局情報機關一網打盡。

〈北韓也防不了自己人？前軍方駭客攻破銀行，盜國家資金轉進加密幣〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Ariel，加密城市
Daily NK：北韓兩大銀行系統遭本國前軍方駭客滲透
由脫北者經營的 《每日北韓 Daily NK》報導，一個由退伍軍事駭客組成的犯罪集團，近期被查出入侵北韓朝鮮中央銀行與貿易銀行的內部網路系統。
這個駭客集團把竊取到的國家貿易資金換成加密貨幣，並在邊境地區大規模走私外幣，而北韓國家情報院（前身為國家保衛省）已於 7 月 12 日將這個集團一網打盡。
朝鮮中央銀行負責國家貨幣發行與國庫資金管理，貿易銀行則負責處理對外支付與外匯交易，兩者皆屬北韓金融體系核心單位，此次遭到內部人員入侵，讓平壤當局大為震驚。
《CoinDesk》與《Cybernews》也分別引用《Daily NK》消息來源進行報導，但都強調相關內容尚無法獨立查證。
退伍軍方駭客結合高材生，建立地下加密貨幣網路
消息人士對《Daily NK》透露，這起事件的主謀是幾名從北韓偵察總局（現偵察情報總局，長期以網路間諜與駭客行動聞名）轉役的退伍軍人。
這些人退伍後，招募了金策工業綜合大學與平壤理工大學的年輕資訊科技人才，共同建立一套刻意規避國家監控的加密貨幣交易網路，目的是為自己賺取外幣並累積財富。
為了躲避追查，集團使用中國製的特殊無線通訊設備與加密通訊軟體，並運用軍旅與大學時期累積的駭客技術，成功入侵兩家銀行的內部系統與跨境支付機制。
得手後，他們將分散在人頭帳戶中的國家貿易資金與外幣，拆分成小額多筆轉出，再轉入海外加密貨幣錢包，透過中國掮客兌換成現金，並由新義州、惠山等邊境地區的聯絡人即時換成美元與人民幣。
情報機關循線追查，安全屋一舉逮捕全員
消息人士指出，北韓官方最初是在核對外幣支付審批時，發現金額出現細微落差，同時也偵測到可疑的境外 IP 存取紀錄，國家情報院隨即展開秘密內部調查。
調查人員循著加密貨幣交易的加密流量，鎖定平壤市內一處安全屋，並於 7 月 12 日夜間展開突襲，當場逮捕正在電腦前洗錢的主謀與資訊人員，查扣價值數十萬美元的電腦設備，以及集團用來規避監控的多支未登記門號手機。
行動當晚，武裝情報人員一度在貿易銀行總部與朝鮮中央銀行電腦中心周邊部署警戒，切斷對外連線，並派出訊號偵測車在平壤市內追蹤集團使用的異常無線頻率，市區一度氣氛緊張。
消息傳出後，在平壤菁英階層、軍方與大學圈引發不小震撼，據悉當局預期將對涉案人員從重量刑。
北韓駭客洗錢問題由來已久，國際持續關注動向
這起銀行內部盜用案雖屬個案，但也再次凸顯北韓長年利用網路技術從事非法金流的問題。
根據區塊鏈分析公司 CertiK 今年 5 月發布的報告，北韓相關駭客集團在 2025 年造成的加密貨幣損失高達 20.6 億美元，占全球加密貨幣竊盜損失的 60%，2016 年以來累計竊取金額更達 67.5 億美元。
報告作者 Taylor Monahan 指出，社交工程是北韓駭客集團最主要的攻擊手法，而失竊資金往往能在極短時間內，透過去中心化交易所與跨鏈橋洗白。
CertiK 也提到，美國司法部去年 6 月曾對一筆與北韓資訊工作者洗錢網路有關、金額 770 萬美元的加密貨幣提出民事沒收訴訟。
案件文件顯示，北韓受制裁的貿易銀行代表沈亨燮（Sim Hyon Sop，音譯）掌控的一個錢包，在 2021 年 8 月至 2023 年 3 月間收到超過 2,400 萬美元的加密貨幣。
此次銀行內部遭滲透一案，再度顯示北韓在對外進行加密貨幣攻擊之餘，內部金融體系同樣面臨資安漏洞的挑戰。
（以上內容獲合作夥伴《加密城市》授權節錄及轉載，原文連結 ）

title: 美債快破 40 兆、美元危機要來了？《富爸爸》：快買比特幣、以太幣
summary:
《 富爸爸 窮爸爸》作者清崎警告美國國債逼近 40 兆美元，呼籲投資人持有黃金、白銀與加密貨幣等硬資產，對抗法幣貶值風險。

〈美債快破 40 兆、美元危機要來了？《富爸爸》：快買比特幣、以太幣〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Kurumi，加密城市
清崎再度示警，美國債務逼近 40 兆美元
《富爸爸窮爸爸》作者羅伯特・清崎（Robert Kiyosaki）再度對美元與美國財政風險發出警告。他近日在 X 平台發文指出，美國國債已逼近 39 兆美元，並把目前債務規模與 2008 年全球金融危機前相比。當時美國國債約為 9.5 兆美元，如今已成長超過 4 倍，債務擴張速度讓他認為美元購買力正面臨更大壓力。
根據市場追蹤資料，美國國債截至 7 月 22 日已達約 39.64 兆美元，距離 40 兆美元關卡只剩一步之遙。
清崎形容，美國政府近年持續透過舉債與貨幣擴張支撐財政，甚至稱政府大約每 90 天就增加約 1 兆美元債務。他也用「若每分鐘花 1 美元，花完 1 兆美元需要約 32,000 年」的方式，凸顯債務規模已遠超一般人可直觀理解的範圍。
從白銀、黃金到 BTC 與 ETH，硬資產策略延續數十年
清崎長期主張遠離單純持有法幣存款，並把資金轉向供給有限、難以被政府任意增發的資產。他表示，自己自 1965 年開始持有白銀，1971 年開始持有黃金，2012 年開始持有比特幣（$BTC），2022 年則開始持有以太幣（$ETH）。
這套配置反映他的核心觀點：當政府債務與貨幣供給持續擴張，投資人應透過硬資產保護購買力。
在他的資產敘事中，黃金與白銀代表傳統避險工具，比特幣則因 2,100 萬枚固定供給上限，被視為對抗法幣貶值的新型儲值資產。以太幣的角色則不同，它承載智能合約、 DeFi 、穩定幣與鏈上金融應用，讓清崎把以太幣視為數位金融基礎設施的一部分。他也曾表示，自己把部分黃金與白銀存放在海外保管庫，以降低單一司法轄區政策風險。
激進價格預測引發討論，崩盤時程屢遭質疑
清崎對市場崩盤與資產價格的預測一向激進。他過去曾預測，若金融泡沫破裂，黃金可能升至每盎司 35,000 美元，白銀可能達到 200 美元，比特幣可能升至 750,000 美元，以太幣甚至可能達到 95,000 美元。這些目標價遠高於目前市場水準，也讓他的說法每次出現都容易引發加密社群與傳統投資人討論。
不過，市場批評者也指出，清崎多年來反覆警告美元崩潰與金融市場重置，但實際發生時間常與其預測不符。硬資產本身也存在明顯限制，黃金與白銀不產生現金流，比特幣與以太幣則具備高波動特徵，價格可能在短時間內大幅回撤。
對一般投資人而言，將美元債務危機直接等同於比特幣與以太幣必然上漲，仍需要承擔市場週期、流動性與政策變化風險。
美元信任壓力升高，避險敘事重新升溫
清崎的最新發言之所以受到關注，背景在於美國債務擴張、利息支出升高與通膨壓力仍未完全消退。若政府持續以舉債支應財政支出，市場將更頻繁討論美元信用、美債需求與聯準會政策彈性。這也讓黃金、比特幣與其它稀缺資產重新成為投資人檢視資產配置時的選項。
現階段，清崎的警告仍屬個人投資觀點，並非市場共識。真正值得觀察的是，美國債務逼近 40 兆美元後，全球資金是否會更積極分散至黃金、比特幣、以太幣與其它非主權資產。對加密市場而言，美元危機敘事能帶來長線買盤想像，但短線價格仍會受到利率、 ETF 資金、流動性與監管政策牽動。
（以上內容獲合作夥伴《加密城市》授權節錄及轉載，原文連結 ）

title: SK 海力士永續合約驚見「閃崩」！1 分鐘暴跌 20% 、韓股開盤跟跌 15%
summary:
南韓晶片大廠 SK 海力士（SK Hynix）永續合約在今（28）日亞洲盤前驚爆「閃崩」，一分鐘內暴跌 20% 至 900 美元。數小時後，SK 海力士現貨股價在韓股開盤後果然大跌，令市場關注：加密貨幣衍生品市場是否提前反映傳統金融市場情緒。

〈SK 海力士永續合約驚見「閃崩」！1 分鐘暴跌 20% 、韓股開盤跟跌 15%〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
南韓晶片大廠 SK 海力士（SK Hynix）本月稍早才剛在那斯達克（Nasdaq）發行美國存託憑證（ADR），但在 Hyperliquid 上追蹤該股的永續合約，卻在今（28）日亞洲盤前驚爆「閃崩」，一分鐘內暴跌 20% 至 900 美元。數小時後，SK 海力士現貨股價在韓股開盤後果然大跌，令市場關注：加密貨幣衍生品市場是否提前反映傳統金融市場情緒。
根據 Hyperliquid 數據顯示，今晨 07:00 至 07:01 短短一分鐘內，追蹤 SK 海力士的永續合約價格狂瀉 20%，瞬間跌至 900 美元，豈料卻在下一分鐘迅速強彈、收復 1,000 美元大關。
在加密貨幣市場中，這類閃崩事件屢見不鮮，特別是在美股收盤後、中國與南韓等亞洲股市尚未開盤的「交接空窗期」，由於這個時段的市場流動性相對薄弱，因此極易爆發劇烈價格波動。
果不其然，在 SK 海力士永續合約閃崩一小時後，南韓股市隨即以暴跌開出，並由半導體族群領跌。截至當日收盤，SK 海力士股價重挫 15%，來到 1,550,000 韓元（約 1,762 美元）；指標權值股如三星電子（Samsung Electronics）、現代汽車（Hyundai Motor）也無一倖免，拖累南韓 KOSPI 綜合指數狂瀉 11% 。此外，SK 海力士的 ADR（每 10 單位 ADR 表彰 1 股普通股）在美股盤前交易也同步下跌 4.5%，報 136.51 美元。
作為輝達（NVIDIA）AI 處理器中高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的主要供應商，SK 海力士近期的股價表現卻慘遭血洗。若從 6 月 26 日寫下的 194.7 萬韓元高點起算，至今跌幅已達近 48% 。
這波跌勢並非侷限於單一個股，華爾街對整體 AI 概念股的投資情緒正顯著降溫。本周稍早，在《華爾街日報》披露輝達可能將為 OpenAI 旗下的資料中心計畫，提供高達約 2,500 億美元的財務擔保後，輝達股價應聲下挫 5% 。
近年來，Hyperliquid 已成為全球最大的去中心化永續合約交易平台，尤其自今年初中東地緣政治局勢升溫以來，愈來愈多交易員透過 Hyperliquid 交易與傳統金融資產連結的永續合約，以布局股票、指數等市場行情，而非僅限於加密貨幣。

title: 鏈上忙翻天、幣價跌不停！研究：ETH 、 SOL 、 AVAX「基本面與價格背離」
summary:
儘管過去一年加密貨幣市場逆風頻吹，以太幣、Solana（SOL）和 Avalanche（AVAX）價格腰斬，但這 3 大公鏈的基本面卻呈現出截然不同的光景，不僅鏈上活躍度持續攀升、交易手續費大幅降低，機構投資人的進場意願、質押參與度更是居高不下。在跌跌不休的幣價背後，為何聰明錢反而加速湧入底層網路？

〈鏈上忙翻天、幣價跌不停！研究：ETH 、 SOL 、 AVAX「基本面與價格背離」〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
儘管過去一年加密貨幣市場逆風頻吹，以太幣、 Solana（SOL）和 Avalanche（AVAX）價格腰斬，但這 3 大公鏈的基本面卻呈現出截然不同的光景，不僅鏈上活躍度持續攀升、交易手續費大幅降低，機構投資人的進場意願、質押參與度更是居高不下。在跌跌不休的幣價背後，為何聰明錢反而加速湧入底層網路？
Bitwise 鏈上研究主管 Kam Benbrik 周一表示：「我們觀察到，網路基本面與市場情緒之間出現巨大分歧。」
與 2025 年的榮景相比，現在的幣價表現確實低迷。但從鏈上數據來看，區塊鏈的交易成本變得更親民，且實際的鏈上活動正在逆勢成長。
交易更便宜、活動更多，但收入銳減
Bitwise 近期發布首份「季度質押報告」揭露，雖然臉上活動增加且交易成本下降，但以太坊、 Solana 與 Avalanche 的營收卻大幅衰退。
Bitwise 解釋，收入下降的主因並非需求疲弱，而是各大公鏈近年持續調整協議設計，增加區塊空間、降低交易手續費，這才使網路變得更便宜、更容易使用。
Bitwise 表示：「收入下滑主要來自協議設計的改變。各大公鏈持續提升區塊容量並降低使用成本，部分網路確實受到需求放緩影響，但這並非整體市場的主要趨勢。」
機構質押成主流
報告另一項重點，是機構投資人正快速成為以太坊質押市場的核心力量。 Bitwise 指出，今年新增進入以太坊驗證者池的大部分以太幣，實際上都來自現貨 ETF 、企業資產儲備及其他大型機構持有人。
研究人員指出，以太坊與 Solana 的質押獎勵多數來自新代幣發行，因此選擇不質押的持有者將面臨稀釋風險。此外，隨著越來越多資金湧入質押池，獎勵被不斷瓜分，整體收益率隨之降低。
以太幣質押率創新高
截至今年第二季末，以太坊質押量達 4,020 萬枚以太幣，占總供應量的三分之一，寫下歷史新高。 Kam Benbrik 表示：「當我們追蹤鏈上資金流向時，可以非常明確觀察到，這些資金其實都來自機構投資人。」
以全球最大的以太幣儲備公司 Bitmine 為例，該公司所持有的約 580 萬枚以太幣中，如今已有高達 490 萬枚投入質押，正是機構擁抱質押的絕佳縮影。
根據 Bitwise 第二季報告，以太坊年化質押收益率為 2.84%； Solana 為 6.25% 。然而，值得投資人留意的是，以太坊高達 93% 的質押獎勵，以及 Solana 超過 90% 的獎勵，實則皆源自於「新幣增發」，而非來自用戶支付的交易手續費。
Kam Benbrik 表示，Bitwise 的客戶參與質押，除了為了獲取收益，也是為了支持底層網路的運作：
同時，我們也觀察到許多投資人既想賺取質押收益，又不想放棄資金的流動性，以便在鏈上進行其他操作。針對這類需求，「流動性質押」就成了最佳解方。
他解釋，透過這類協議，投資人不僅能賺取底層的質押收益，還能拿著憑證代幣在 DeFi 市場進行放貸、提供流動性，或將其作為抵押品進行借貸，大幅提高資金的使用效率。

title: Naga Munchetty to leave BBC Breakfast after 17 years
summary: The BBC One show's co-host will swap the TV sofa for the presenter's chair on Radio 5 Live Breakfast.
full_text:
Naga Munchetty to leave BBC Breakfast after 17 years
- Published
BBC Breakfast co-host Naga Munchetty is leaving the show after 17 years, and will swap the TV sofa for the presenter's chair on Radio 5 Live's breakfast show.
Munchetty joined BBC One's Breakfast as a finance reporter and has been one of the main hosts for the past 12 years.
She currently presents the TV show for three days a week and 5 Live's mid-morning programme for another three days. From January, she will present 5 Live Breakfast five days a week.
"It has been a privilege to be part of the BBC Breakfast TV team for the past 17 years, working alongside an incredibly talented and hard-working group of journalists who are not only outstanding colleagues but also great friends," she said.
"Presenting a flagship programme on 5 Live is an opportunity that was simply too good to pass up.
"It will take a huge amount of work and require 100% of my focus and energy, and I'm really looking forward to throwing myself into the role."
John McAndrew, the BBC's director of live and daily news, said Munchetty would be "hugely missed by the millions of viewers who've welcomed her into their homes each week".
He added: "I'm very pleased that Naga will be staying with the BBC and I wish her the best of luck at 5 Live."
Her replacement on BBC Breakfast has not yet been announced, while 5 Live Breakfast will get a new co-host to join Munchetty in the radio studio.
5 Live Breakfast hosts to leave
5 Live Breakfast's current hosts Rachel Burden and Rick Edwards announced on Tuesday's show that they will be leaving the programme.
Burden, who will move to Munchetty's Monday-to-Wednesday mid-morning slot on 5 Live, said: "After 15 years hosting 5 Live Breakfast, I've decided it's time for a change - and I'm really excited about launching my new show on the station."
Edwards, who will remain host of weekend sport quiz Fighting Talk, said he would miss "our wonderful audience", the team and Burden - who he described as "a colleague who has become a friend, and also a mentor, because she's so much older than me".
He added: "Two things I am of course looking forward to are not waking up at 3.45am, and vaping without fear of violent recrimination."
Munchetty is among the best-paid presenters on the BBC's star salaries list, earning about £360,000 a year, according to the latest accounts.
She has interviewed major celebrities and politicians on the programme over the years ranging from Hillary Clinton and Michelle Obama to Sir Keir Starmer, Sir David Attenborough and Sir Rod Stewart.
In 2016, she appeared on the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing.
She has also been at the centre of some controversies during her time on BBC Breakfast.
In 2019, she was initially found to have breached the BBC's guidelines over comments she made about a social media post from Donald Trump about four female politicians of colour.
However, the BBC's director general then reversed that finding after deciding her words were not "sufficient to merit" upholding part of the complaint.
In 2021, Munchetty and co-presenter Charlie Stayt were "spoken to and reminded of their responsibilities" after complaints about their reaction to a government minister's flag. Munchetty apologised for liking "offensive" tweets about the exchange.
In June 2025, the Sun reported details of two alleged incidents which the paper said caused BBC bosses to speak to Munchetty about her conduct.
That came amid reports of behind-the-scenes tensions on the show, and at the same time as the programme's editor Richard Frediani took extended leave following allegations about his behaviour.
The BBC said it did not comment on individual cases but took all complaints about conduct at work extremely seriously.
Munchetty and Frediani did not comment on the reports.

title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
summary: The film has won rave reviews from film critics but a translator of Homer's work was less than impressed.
full_text:
Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
- Published
Sir Christopher Nolan's latest film, The Odyssey, may have won rave reviews from critics and done storming business at the box office - but one person is definitely not happy.
Emily Wilson, the academic whose 2017 translation of Homer's Odyssey was cited by the director as an influence on his adaptation of the poem, has written a scathing review of the movie.
Published in the London Review of Books, external, Wilson said she "would be ashamed to have written any of this script", describing the film's narrative structure as "gimmicky."
"The writing is abysmal," she said. "None of the characters has convincing motivation for their actions or words. There are no sex scenes, and all the food looks horrible."
"It lacks psychological, emotional, political and ethical depth," Wilson wrote, while also acknowledging that Sir Christopher's work had sparked renewed interest in Homer's classic.
"The release of The Odyssey is still an event to celebrate," Wilson noted.
"This epic is bringing audiences back to cinemas... translations of Odyssey, including mine, are flying off the shelves... [and] perhaps the film will persuade a few college administrators not to cut their literature, language and history departments.
"Nolan... is doing his best to get the general public reading again, and I am grateful."
But she was left largely disappointed by the three-hour epic
"I had hoped that Nolan's affinity with these Homeric themes might push him to new creative heights, and enable him to conjure more believable characters," she wrote.
"But The Odyssey features his usual combination of grandiosity and superficiality... the film's vision is too confused, its characters too underdeveloped, to deliver what it half-promises in terms of big ideas – although it is very good at conveying big bangs and big giants."
Wilson added that her teenagers had "had a good time" seeing the blockbuster at the cinema.
"It's a family-friendly audiovisual spectacle, like an elaborate Fourth of July fireworks display - and with about the same level of narrative and emotional depth," she said.
"There are more female characters than in most Nolan movies, thanks to the source material. But none of them has much to say, in contrast to the characterisations in the poem."
During his press tour for the film, Sir Christopher told Empire magazine, external that he used the opening line of Wilson's translation ("Tell me about a complicated man") as a guide for his Odysseus, played by Matt Damon.
In contrast to Wilson's take, the latest adaptation has received rapturous reviews from film critics.
It is the director's first movie since 2023's Oppenheimer, which won the Academy Award for best picture.
The Telegraph declared The Odyssey the "film of the year", while Metro added that the movie would "change cinema forever".
The Times described it as "a masterpiece in every way", and the Standard praised the film as a "colossal piece of cinema".
The Odyssey, which was released earlier this month, stars Matt Damon, Zendaya, Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, Anne Hathaway, Charlize Theron and Lupita Nyong'o.
It follows Odysseus (Damon), the Greek king of Ithaca, on his long and perilous journey home from the Trojan War to rescue his wife and son (Hathaway and Holland).

title: Zelensky to press Trump on air defences while in Washington
summary: Ukraine's leader is hoping to firm up US commitments to bolstering Kyiv's anti-ballistic missile defences, as Russia has escalated deadly attacks.
full_text:
Zelensky to press Trump on air defences while in Washington
- Published
Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky is due to hold important talks with US President Donald Trump at the White House, where he is hoping to firm up commitments to bolstering Kyiv's anti-ballistic missile defences.
Zelensky has arrived in the US at a significant stage in Russia's full-scale war in Ukraine, with Moscow's mayor saying the capital was targeted by 390 drones in a matter of hours overnight.
The Ukrainian leader is expected to press Trump over support he gave earlier this month for Kyiv to be given a licence to produce Patriot interceptor missiles.
Russia has escalated deadly ballistic missile attacks on Ukraine's capital recently, and Zelensky has said interceptors are urgently needed.
Patriot missiles have been at the top of Zelensky's wish-list for some time, but after the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, these US air defence interceptors are in very short supply.
Promising a licence is one thing, but co-producing the highly sophisticated PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptors on Ukrainian soil is another, because it involves a lengthy political, legal and technical process.
A delegation from US manufacturer Raytheon visited Kyiv last week and Zelensky said the defence firm had expressed "readiness to take our partnership to an even higher level".
After he speaks with Zelensky, Trump will have another important meeting - with Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu. It is the first time the two have met in person since the war on Iran started in late February.
Zelensky and Netanyahu are in Washington to attend the funeral of Senator Lindsey Graham, who died this month aged 71.
The Ukraine war appeared to coincide with the US-Israel war with Iran at the weekend, when Ukrainian forces targeted an Iranian cargo ship in the Caspian Sea.
Kyiv has described Iran as a "direct accomplice to Russian aggression against Ukraine" and Zelensky has said Ukrainian intelligence has evidence that Russia has shared satellite imagery with Tehran, enabling Iran to attack US military facilities and Gulf states.
Trump has said he will "find out if that's true. I'll ask Putin about it", while saying if true, it had no impact at all.
Meanwhile, in Moscow, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said more than 390 Ukrainian drones had targeted the region between 20:30 on Monday and 06:30 on Tuesday local time, and that most had been intercepted by air defences.
Footage confirmed by BBC Verify showed damage to a high-rise building in Chekhov, south of the capital and a fire at a warehouse in Berezhki to the west. Local officials in Chekhov said there had been no casualties.
Since Zelensky last spoke to Trump in early July, Ukraine has repeatedly targeted logistics hubs, many belonging to Russian e-commerce company Wildberries, exacerbating issues faced by small and medium-sized business in parts of Russia.
Speaking at the Kremlin on Monday, President Vladimir Putin told members of Russia's parliament, the Duma, that their country's enemies were resorting to "terrorist methods" against civilians but would "never break" the Russian people.
"We will achieve our objectives and will together do everything for victory, for Russia," Putin said.
At the weekend, he was confronted over the war's objectives by an ally, Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, who said the roots of the war were "not understandable".
Tokayev said a peace deal with Ukraine could be reached if the war was halted for negotiations to take place.
"Perhaps it is time to freeze this conflict and return to the Istanbul formula 2.0," Toyakev suggested, referring to talks that began shortly after Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
summary: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.
full_text:
US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
- Published
The US delegation walked out of a UN Security Council meeting on Monday, in protest at comments made by France that compared Washington's voting on human rights to that of authoritarian states.
The diplomatic row was initially sparked last week, when the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending Volker Turk's term as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.
After the vote on Friday, France's UN mission criticised the US and compared it to North Korea and Russia. "The US used to be a beacon of human rights. Not anymore," it posted on X, external.
In response, US ambassador Mike Waltz accused France of voting for a human rights chief who had been "lecturing" democratic countries while "cozying up to the world's worst oppressors", without elaborating on what he meant.
Turk has criticised Russia's war in Ukraine and Israel's military conduct in Gaza.
The US team's walkout came while France's ambassador Jerome Bonnafont was speaking during an emergency Security Council meeting on Russia's war in Ukraine.
US ambassador Dan Negrea said the delegation would continue to make similar protests until France "renounces their condescending and disrespectful rhetoric".
The fight over Turk's second term, which was passed with 144 states in favour, 10 against and 13 abstentions, reflects tensions between Washington and the United Nations.
The Trump administration has cut funding for UN agencies and withdrawn from dozens of its entities.
On Friday, US ambassador Jeff Bartos criticised Turk's reappointment and said "there will be consequences" to the assembly which "tolerates procedural overreach, backroom deals, and the misuse of UN posts".
"The United States will immediately reassess our engagement, participation, and funding," he said.
However, French ambassador Bonnafont described Turk as "a voice of conscience" who demonstrated "rigor and impartiality" during his first term.
Deputy UN spokesperson Farhan Haq declined to comment on the US walkout, adding the UN expected all member states to respect the decision.

title: MP's shock as French warship in Channel 'fires shots'
summary: Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp says the vessel fired 17 shots as he was giving a BBC interview.
full_text:
MP's shock as French warship in Channel 'fires shots'
- Published
An MP has said a French patrol boat fired gunshots while he was in the English Channel conducting media interviews.
Chris Philp MP was being interviewed about small boat crossings by BBC South East when what he believes to be a French warship passed by.
Noises which sounded like gunshots were then heard in the background, according to BBC journalist Michael Keohan.
The BBC has approached the French coastguard for comment on what happened.
Keohan said 17 gunshots rung out mid-interview.
No notice or training exercise were in place, with Philp saying he believed it was an intimidation tactic or warning shots.
He said it "felt to me like an attempted intimidation to stop us covering migrant crossings".
At sea, Keohan described it as "the most unusual moment... in the quiet of the Channel" when 17 gunshots rung out mid-interview.
He said he saw a French patrol officer at the back of the boat pointing a pistol towards the sea and believed that was where the shots came from.
Keohan added: "There was no warning for our boat, no signs given, that this was the French's intention.
"Even now it's still not clear what the patrol boat was aiming at."

title: How afraid should we be of jellyfish off UK shores?
summary: Many people are scared of the jellyfish due to the fear of painful stings and the creature's unpredictable nature in the water.
full_text:
How afraid should we be of Scotland's jellyfish?
- Published
When scuba diver and underwater photographer Ross McLaren encountered a jellyfish for the first time, he said all he felt was "sheer terror".
"I was diving in the Clyde and one of the instructors had to pull me out of the way of the tentacles as it was wafting above me," he said.
McLaren ended up with a sting across his upper lip but said it did not stop him from wanting to dive.
Many people are scared of jellyfish due to the fear of painful stings and the creature's unpredictable nature in the water.
But McLaren, who lives near the coast in North Ayrshire, believes there is more to the brainless, heartless and boneless invertebrates than people might think.
"Jellyfish have such a bad reputation but they are one of the most mesmerising and beautiful creatures underwater," he said, having completed almost 600 dives.
As we reach peak jellyfish season in Scotland, should we see them as a sight to behold or a reason to run?
When do you see the most jellyfish in Scotland?
July and August are peak months for jellyfish sightings in Scotland.
"The number and distribution of jellyfish are impacted by many different factors," said Anna Bunney of the Marine Conservation Society, which runs a nationwide survey of jellyfish.
"This includes sea temperatures, the availability of plankton for feeding, which peaks during the summer months when it is warmer, and ocean currents."
Sea temperatures tend to lag behind air temperatures, Bunney says.
The maximum air temperatures in Scotland usually occur in July and August, whereas sea temperatures are at the warmest in August and September.
When the sea starts to get warmer, it means a return of the jellyfish.
Bunney described jellyfish as weak swimmers or "passive drifters" which rely on ocean currents to carry them.
Calmer ocean conditions around the UK in the summer months help to push jellyfish gently towards the shore, meaning there are often more sightings of the creatures.
Breeding speed also increases with warmer conditions, allowing adult jellyfish to reproduce in large numbers, creating so-called blooms.
These blooms can look like a thick soup or pulsing cloud in the water and have been known to block boat engines.
In 2011, Torness nuclear power station in East Lothian was even shut down as a precautionary measure due to huge numbers of jellyfish found in sea water entering the plant.
McLaren added that while jellyfish season is normally April to October, the creatures can still be seen in Scotland's waters all year round.
"You see them in the winter months but they are far more prevalent and common during the summer," he said.
What happens if a jellyfish stings you?
Jellyfish stings in Scotland are not usually life-threatening but can be very painful.
Depending on the type of jellyfish, the stingers may not be sharp enough or long enough to pierce the skin.
Bunney said most jellyfish have stinging cells but the severity and detectability of the sting varies widely between species.
Swimmers should be aware of the Lion's Mane, which is a brownish orange colour, and prevalent around Scotland's coastline in the warmer summer months.
They have long tentacles which can give a sore but not lethal sting.
The tentacles can break off and float around in the sea or become attached to chains on a boat, for example, but the stinging cells will stay alive even when not attached to the main body.
Bunney, who said she has been stung a lot by jellyfish, compared a mild sting to that of a nettle.
"There was one point when every time over a period of two years I was stung by a jellyfish when I was out in the sea," she said.
"But thankfully, it hasn't impacted how I feel about the ocean.
"In fact, what I often think is the most frustrating is when you are stung but you cannot see what you have been stung by."
McLaren said he has never been put off scuba diving by the prospect of a jellyfish sting but he can understand why swimmers might be nervous.
"When you're diving, as long as the visibility is good, you can negotiate your way around a jellyfish relatively easily, if you know what way the current is flowing and you pay attention," he said.
"Swimming, on the other hand, I totally get it - if I was taking my kids down to the beach and there were a lot of jellyfish I would probably stop them from getting in the water.
"When you're swimming you tend to have your head out of the water more so you can't always see what is underneath or know where the tentacles are going."
Both Bunney and McLaren added that it is important not to touch a jellyfish when it is washed up on a beach as it can still sting, even when presumed dead.
Bunney said to follow NHS guidance after a jellyfish sting.
It suggests using tweezers or the edge of a bank card to remove the tentacles as soon as possible as they can continue to sting while attached to the body.
A heat pack or immersion in hot water can reduce pain and swelling, and painkillers such as paracetamol can also help.
If symptoms because more severe or a sensitive part of body has been stung, seek medical help.
Why do jellyfish sting?
Unlike bees or wasps, which sting as a defence mechanism to protect themselves, a jellyfish sting is an automatic reflex, not a deliberate attack.
"A common misconception is jellyfish go after people but contact with a jellyfish is actually merely incidental and humans are not on their menu," Bunney said.
"They are not actively stinging, it is just when anything touches their tentacles as they are moving through the water, regardless of what it is."
Jellyfish tentacles are lined with thousands of venom-filled stinging cells.
When touched, these cells fire toxic harpoon-like tubes designed to paralyse prey, such as plankton and small fish.
Should jellyfish stop you from swimming in the sea?
"Do not be afraid but be cautious" is the advice from Bunney, who generally recommends swimming calmly away from jellyfish.
"Most of the species found in Scotland have very mild stings, which only cause minor irritation, and some are completely harmless," she said.
Bunney says it is important for people to learn about the different species of jellyfish and report sightings to the Marine Conservation Society.
"People think jellyfish are ugly," she said. "But they are really beautiful creatures that come in all different colours and sizes."
McLaren echoed the love for the marine invertebrate.
"People hate jellyfish but I always do my best to take a photo of one when I see it because they are impressive to see in the water," he said.
"It's almost like stars in the night sky when you are on the sea floor and looking up at the jellyfish above you.
"It's magical."

title: Ariana Grande sues hackers who leaked music and videos
summary: The pop star is suing to discover the identity of hackers who obtained unreleased photos and songs.
full_text:
Ariana Grande sues hackers who leaked music and videos
- Published
Pop star Ariana Grande has filed a lawsuit against two unidentified hackers who, she claims, leaked unreleased music and studio footage after gaining access to her collaborators' computers.
In papers filed in Los Angeles and reported by US media outlets, the singer alleged the hackers had targeted photographers and producers' in order to access material that was sold "on the dark web" for "significant sums of money".
"In 2023 alone, 45 unreleased songs belonging to Ms Grande were hacked, stolen, and leaked," the documents said. "Since her music debut in 2011, hundreds of similar leaks have taken place."
Her lawyers said she was initiating legal action to uncover the identity of the hackers.
Grande has previously expressed her desire to hold hackers accountable for leaking unreleased music.
During an interview with the Zach Sang show in 2024, she spoke about a song called Fantasize, written with Swedish pop savant Max Martin, which went viral after being posted online.
"Before I left for Wicked - [there were] a few studio sessions that I did which are all over TikTok, thank you so much, I'll see you in jail. Literally," she said.
"Those were all written for a TV show, for something that was not for me, so Fantasize comes out, crazy, was stolen... These pirates, crooks, illegal!"
Her legal case outlined an alleged pattern of illegal behaviour, in which the accounts of Grande's co-workers were systematically targeted over several years.
In 2025, it claimed, the defendants hacked into the mobile device of a producer who had collaborated with Grande and accessed unreleased masters, demos and footage from recording sessions.
The previous year, the suit claimed, hackers created an email account impersonating a photographer, and persuaded a digital technician to send them unreleased photos that belonged to Grande.
The singer accused the hackers of violating the "sacred relationship that exists between her and her fans" and is suing for invasion of privacy, violation of California computer hacking laws, and conversion.
Her lawyers said the "malicious invasion of Ms. Grande's privacy and disruption of her career have caused her substantial and irreparable harm due to this breach of privacy."
The court filing comes as Grande prepares for the release of her eighth studio album, Petal, this Friday.
She is currently in the middle of a world tour, which is due to hit the UK in August.
Grande previously hinted the concerts would be her last for "a long time".
"I'm going to give it my all and it's going to be beautiful," she told Amy Poehler's Good Hang podcast, external. "I think that's why I'm doing it because I'm like: 'One last hurrah' - for now."

title: Zinedine Zidane confirmed as new France manager
summary: Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.
full_text:
Zidane confirmed as France head coach
- Published
Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.
Didier Deschamps, France's longest-serving manager, ended his 14-year stint in charge after the nation's semi-final exit to Spain at the 2026 World Cup.
Zidane, a World Cup winner with France in 1998, has been out of management since leaving Real Madrid for a second time as head coach in 2021.
The 54-year-old, widely considered to be France's greatest player, will sign a contract that will see him lead the nation through the 2030 World Cup qualifiers.
On being appointed, he said it was "a great source of pride" to lead the French national side following their fourth-place finish at the World Cup.
"I've often said it: there's nothing greater than the French national team. So it's a joy and obviously a great source of pride to become the manager of this French national team," he added.
"It's also a responsibility. I want to thank [French Football Federation] president Philippe Diallo, the executive committee, and the French Football Federation for their confidence and acknowledge the 14 years of service from Didier and his staff.
"I also have a special thought today for all my coaches. Needless to say, I have high ambitions for the French national team."
Diallo described the new head coach as a "legend" of French football.
"The appointment of Zinedine Zidane as head coach of the French national team is a source of immense pride for the French Football Federation," he said.
"It marks the meeting of a legend in the history of Les Bleus, who has become one of the most decorated and respected coaches of his generation, and a team with rare potential, driven by the highest ambitions."
Zidane's predecessor Deschamps guided France to three major finals over his 14-year reign, helping the country to their second World Cup success with victory in 2018.
Zidane's first competitive fixture in charge will be a Nations League trip to Turkey on 25 September.
Zidane's trophy-laden managerial career
After retiring as a player following the 2006 World Cup, Zidane did not enter management until 2014, when he became coach of Real Madrid Castilla - the club's B team.
He stepped up to become the first team manager in January 2016, and by the end of that season had led them to Champions League success with a victory over city rivals Atletico Madrid in the final on penalties.
That was the first of three successive Champions League titles for Madrid, making them the first club to win back-to-back European crowns in the Champions League era, and the first to win three titles in a row since Bayern Munich in 1976.
He also won La Liga in 2016-17, but departed after the following season, saying change was needed at the Bernabeu.
However, Zidane returned to Madrid in March 2019 with the club in poor form, and won another Spanish league title in 2019-20.
He also oversaw a period of extensive spending at Madrid, including the signings of Eden Hazard and Rodrygo.
But Zidane left at the end of a trophyless 2020-21 campaign, and has not managed since.
Zidane has long been courted to become France manager and was first linked with the job after the team was knocked out of the 2010 World Cup in the group stage.
Some 16 years later, he has finally taken on the role and will lead the French into qualifying for Euro 2028.
Zidane's legendary playing career
Zidane started his playing career at Cannes in 1989, then played for Bordeaux until joining Juventus in 1996.
An attacking midfielder, he helped the Italian side win back-to-back Serie A titles and reach successive Champions League finals, before joining Real Madrid in 2001.
Zidane moved for £66 million, then the world record transfer fee, as part of Real Madrid's Galacticos era alongside other global stars including Ronaldo, Luis Figo and David Beckham.
He began delivering on that fee in the 2002 Champions League final, scoring a stunning volleyed winner as Madrid beat Bayer Leverkusen 2-1 at Hampden Park.
For the France national team, Zidane made his greatest contribution as a player with two headed goals in the 1998 World Cup final in Paris.
France beat Brazil 3-0 to win the World Cup for the first time, and Zidane won the Ballon d'Or later that year.
Zidane was also part of the France team that won Euro 2000, but endured disappointing campaigns in the 2002 World Cup and Euro 2004.
He retired from international football in 2004, but was persuaded to return during qualifying for the 2006 World Cup.
Zidane was a key player in France advancing through the knock-out stages to the final against Italy - his final match as a professional footballer - and scored the opener with a Panenka penalty off the crossbar after seven minutes.
But Italy equalised and the game went to extra time, during which Zidane headbutted Marco Materazzi and was dismissed. Italy went on to win the final on penalties.

title: Local match goes viral over 'finger-clicking' cheating claim
summary: A viral video appears to show a fielder in a local match clicking his fingers as the ball passes the bat, before the batter is given out caught behind.
full_text:
Local match goes viral over cheating claim
- Published
An amateur cricket match has made global headlines after a fielder was accused of cheating by clicking his fingers to get a wicket.
The North Yorkshire and South Durham Cricket League has started an investigation into a second XI Division 2 game between Saltburn and Norton.
A viral video on social media appears to show a Saltburn fielder clicking his fingers as the ball passes Noman Shabir's bat before being caught by wicketkeeper Josh Bowes. Saltburn appeal and the umpire gives Shabir out.
It has been suggested that the finger-clicking was designed to trick the umpire into thinking the batter edged the ball.
Saltburn won by 159 runs and are top of Division 2 by 17 points.
"The league have received a formal complaint regarding alleged incidents in a Division Two game on Saturday," the league said in a statement on X.
"A full investigation has been initiated and until such time as the formal processes are complete no further comment will be made."
Last week Bowes took eight catches in Saltburn's 22-run win over Shildon Railway. The men's Test record for catches by a keeper in an innings is seven.
Bowes leads the league standings with 31 catches, 10 more than any other player.
Rory Cotterill, who captained Middlesbrough second XI during a 29-run defeat by Saltburn last month, responded to a social media post containing the video and alleged two further incidents of cheating by Saltburn in that match.
The original video of the incident has had more than three million views on X, with publications in Australia and New Zealand among those to report it.
The BBC has contacted the league and Saltburn. Norton declined to comment.

full_text:
Magnitude 7.1 earthquake shakes southern Japan, tsunami warning issued
PM Sanae Takaichi urges people ‘to remain vigilant for the possibility of another earthquake of similar magnitude’.
A magnitude 7.1 earthquake has struck Japan’s southern Kumamoto prefecture, knocking out power to thousands of homes, stopping rail services and triggering tsunami warnings and aftershocks.
The Japanese government issued emergency earthquake warnings on Tuesday for Kumamoto, Nagasaki, Kagoshima, Fukuoka, Saga, Oita, and Miyazaki prefectures, all on Japan’s southern island of Kyushu.

A tsunami warning for waves of up to 1 metre (3.3 feet) was issued following the earthquake, the Japan Meteorological Agency said.
Japan is one of the world’s most earthquake-prone countries, with a tremor occurring at least every five minutes. Located along the “Ring of Fire” of volcanoes and oceanic trenches partly encircling the Pacific Basin, Japan accounts for about 20 percent of the world’s earthquakes of magnitude 6 or more.
In a post on X, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged those in the quake-hit areas “to remain vigilant for the possibility of another earthquake of similar magnitude”, adding that the government was working to assess the extent of damage “as quickly as possible”.
The Japan Times reported that cities in Kumamoto, as well as the neighbouring prefectures of Nagasaki, Kagoshima, Fukuoka, Saga and Miyazaki, felt strong shaking.
The earthquake’s epicentre was located in the city of Uki, just south of the city of Kumamoto, at a depth of 10km (6.2 miles).
Companies, including Sony and TSMC, the world’s largest contract chipmaker, have plants in the quake’s path. There was no immediate clarity on whether any infrastructure was damaged.
Leading energy supplier Kyushu Electric Power said about 40,000 homes had lost electricity as a result of the earthquake, while railway company JR Kyushu said it had suspended services, including its high-speed bullet trains.
There were no irregularities reported at the nuclear power stations in the area, the Nuclear Regulation Authority said.
Two large earthquakes in Kumamoto 10 years ago killed 275 people and injured 2,739, according to an official count.

title: Netanyahu in the White House: What’s on the agenda and what’s next?
summary: The Israeli PM's visit to the US comes amid raids in the occupied West Bank, before the October 27 elections.
full_text:
Netanyahu in the White House: What’s on the agenda and what’s next?
The Israeli PM’s visit to the US comes amid raids in the occupied West Bank, before the October 27 elections.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has arrived in Washington, DC, and will visit the White House on Tuesday, with the war on Iran topping the agenda.
Netanyahu’s visit is his first for talks with President Donald Trump since the United States and Israel launched their war on Iran with strikes on Tehran on February 28. It also comes amid increasing Israeli raids and arrests in the occupied West Bank and three months before elections in Israel.
Recommended Stories
list of 3 items- list 1 of 3How Israel uses settler-soldier terror to colonise the West Bank
- list 2 of 3What is happening in the occupied West Bank?
- list 3 of 3UN eyeing potential Israeli war crimes in Lebanon
He has visited the White House more times under the Trump administration than under any other US president. Political analysts say Netanyahu is seeking Trump’s support for re-election.
What are the two leaders likely to discuss and what happens next in the US-Israel war on Iran?
Here’s what we know:
Why are Trump and Netanyahu meeting now?
Netanyahu is primarily in the US to attend the funeral ceremony of Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, who died on July 11.
Graham was a close Trump ally in the Senate, both on domestic and international matters, including the war on Iran, as well as a staunch supporter of Israel. His funeral ceremony will take place on Tuesday in Washington, DC, beginning at 2pm (19:00 GMT).
Before attending Graham’s memorial, Netanyahu is also expected to meet Trump at 11am (15:00 GMT) in Washington, DC, where protesters have lined the streets in anticipation of his visit.
He is scheduled to fly back to Israel on Wednesday.
What are Trump and Netanyahu likely to discuss?
A White House official told the Reuters news agency that the two leaders were likely to discuss the war on Iran as well as Israeli strikes and occupation of Lebanon, whose president Trump hosted last week. Israel says it is targeting strongholds of the Iran-backed group Hezbollah, which began firing rockets into its north shortly after the war on Iran began. However, Iran says it will not agree to a peace deal unless Israeli forces withdraw from Lebanon.
Reporting from Washington, DC, Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher said many people in Israel believe the US should not make a deal with Iran and should instead resume the war. He said some in the US support this view.
“Now, Trump has expressed his frustration with Netanyahu and has said several times that he feels the Israeli leader is not seeing the big picture. And sometimes you’re not sure whether both men are on the same page or whether they are diametrically opposed to one another. So it will be interesting to see if we get any readout from either side after that meeting,” he said.
Fisher, however, added that the outcome of the meeting between Trump and Netanyahu is currently not expected to be made public.
The White House official also told Reuters that the two leaders would also discuss the Abraham Accords, the series of agreements between Israel and Arab and other nations which Trump began brokering during his first term as US president to normalise diplomatic relations. So far, only the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Morocco, Sudan and Kazakhstan have agreed to sign.
Netanyahu’s visit to Washington, DC comes amid intensifying pogroms and violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinian communities across the occupied West Bank over the weekend following a deadly shootout in the town of Tal, in which two Israelis and four Palestinians were killed.
Israeli settlers have been making a push to increase the number of illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank since 2022, when Netanyahu formed the most far-right government in the country’s history, including ministers who are leading figures in the settler movement.
Expanding the illegal settlements would help Netanyahu garner the far right’s support in the upcoming elections, political observers say.
However, in a letter published on Tuesday, about 600 former Israeli officials appealed to Trump, saying he is the only one capable of helping to avoid the “calamity” of escalating violence in the West Bank and its implications for Israeli, US and regional security.
“Unless arrested swiftly and decisively, escalating violence in the West Bank is poised to ignite the region and carries severe ramifications for both Israeli security and US regional interests,” the letter, written by lobby group Commanders for Israel’s Security (CIS), stated.
“It is our professional judgment that no one but you, Mr President, can avert this calamity.”
CIS is a movement of more than 550 retired Israeli army colonels and generals, as well as equivalent ranks in the intelligence agency Mossad, the internal security agency Shin Bet, police, the foreign service and other corps.
What do Trump and Netanyahu currently disagree on?
The two leaders once appeared politically inseparable, with Netanyahu describing Trump as the “greatest friend Israel has ever had in the White House” last October. Trump returned the praise. During a 2025 appearance in Israel, he joked, “He’s not easy – not the easiest guy to deal with – but that’s what makes him great.”
But Israel’s hostilities with Iran have showcased a crack in Netanyahu and Trump’s alignment.
War on Iran
Last month, Trump reportedly called Netanyahu “f****** crazy” during a phone call and accused him of undermining US diplomatic efforts to end the war on Iran by continuing attacks on Lebanon, among other issues. He warned that Israel’s military escalation risked derailing peace talks with Iran.
“He will have no choice,” Trump told the Financial Times when asked about the likelihood of Netanyahu approving a possible peace agreement with Iran. “I call the shots. I call all the shots. He doesn’t call the shots.”
Political observers say the two leaders are each driven by their own political interests, which are on a collision course. In the US, the war with Iran is deeply unpopular, so Trump needs to reach a deal with Iran to end the war. Netanyahu, on the other hand, could benefit politically at home if it were to continue.
‘Regime change’ in Iran
“Regime change” in Iran appears to be a major sticking point between the two leaders.
Alex Vatanka at the Middle East Institute told Al Jazeera that Netanyahu is likely to try and “sell the idea of regime change again in Tehran” when he meets Trump at the White House on Tuesday.
“I don’t think it will go down well with President Trump because he doesn’t want to do that,” Vatanka said. “Politically, in the US, this war is hugely unpopular, so it remains to be seen what Prime Minister Netanyahu gets out of this meeting.”
He added that previous meetings between Trump and Netanyahu in Washington, DC, have often preceded a flare-up in tensions with Iran, and it remains to be seen whether this one breaks that pattern.
Vatanka said Israelis are still unhappy with the Trump administration about the memorandum of understanding agreed with Tehran, because they “have a different sense of threat perception when it comes to Iran”.
Israeli officials will want Netanyahu to continue to press Trump on Iran’s ballistic missile and nuclear programmes, he said.
“The Trump administration’s counter to that is there is only so much the US can do militarily unless they decide to go in and occupy Iran, and this is something nobody really takes seriously,” he added.
But in a video statement before departing for Washington, DC, Netanyahu said: “In these complex times, you need to act with both great determination and great wisdom. We will discuss all the issues on the agenda, primarily Iran.”
“Of course, our goal is to protect our security and also to expand the circle of peace around us,” he added.
